verdict.rationale: mise handles many items in one command: a single `mise install` installs every tool declared in config, `mise lock --bump --dry-run --json` bumps tool versions in one pass with machine-readable output, `mise bootstrap` applies packages, dotfiles, repos and services together, and dependency-only tasks group other tasks and run prerequisites in parallel. However, none of this is documented as a general bulk-operation capability; it is implied from config-driven commands. missing for 10: explicit docs on bulk/batch selection across arbitrary items (e.g., upgrade or uninstall many tools by pattern), bulk operations exposed through the MCP server for AI agents, independent or hands-on corroboration.
